items: Make up one's mind to do something difficult or costly.
下定決心做一件不容易或要花大錢的事。
Hold one's breath or become completely quiet out of suspense.
屏住呼吸，因緊張或期待而不敢出聲。
Begin to speak freely after struggling to find the words.
打開話匣子，從說不出口變得能自在地說話。
React or act after the moment has already passed.
事過境遷才有所反應，慢了半拍。
Be so blinded by money that judgment suffers.
財迷心竅，因金錢而失去判斷力。
